name: fantasy-edge-iq
description: Fantasy Edge IQ free fantasy analytics dashboards for EuroLeague Fantasy and Fantasy Premier League.

scripts.build: bash -lc 'set -e; rm -rf public; mkdir -p public; shopt -s nullglob; for f in *.html *.csv *.xml *.txt *.png *.svg *.webmanifest; do cp "$f" public/; done; rm -f public/pricing.html; copy(){ if [ -f "$1" ]; then mkdir -p "public/$(dirname "$2")"; cp "$1" "public/$2"; echo "$1 -> public/$2"; else echo "skip missing $1"; fi; }; copy euroleague-dashboard.html euroleague/index.html; copy euroleague-dashboard.html euroleague/dashboard/index.html; copy euroleague-team-analyzer.html euroleague/team-analyzer/index.html; copy euroleague-defense-vs-position.html euroleague/defense-vs-position/index.html; copy premier-league-dashboard.html premier-league/index.html; copy premier-league-dashboard.html premier-league/dashboard/index.html; copy premier-league-team-analyzer.html premier-league/team-analyzer/index.html; copy methodology.html methodology/index.html; copy about.html about/index.html; copy privacy.html privacy/index.html; copy terms.html terms/index.html; copy disclaimer.html disclaimer/index.html; copy sr-index.html sr/index.html; copy sr-euroleague.html sr/euroleague/index.html; copy sr-premier-league.html sr/premier-league/index.html; copy sr-euroleague-defense-vs-position.html sr/euroleague/defense-vs-position/index.html; copy sr-about.html sr/about/index.html; copy sr-methodology.html sr/methodology/index.html; copy sr-privacy.html sr/privacy/index.html; copy sr-terms.html sr/terms/index.html; copy sr-disclaimer.html sr/disclaimer/index.html; copy el-index.html el/index.html; copy el-euroleague.html el/euroleague/index.html; copy el-premier-league.html el/premier-league/index.html; copy el-euroleague-defense-vs-position.html el/euroleague/defense-vs-position/index.html; copy el-about.html el/about/index.html; copy el-methodology.html el/methodology/index.html; copy el-privacy.html el/privacy/index.html; copy el-terms.html el/terms/index.html; copy el-disclaimer.html el/disclaimer/index.html; echo build-ok'
